source.adaptedHow: A test of our own, written from the finding's description, that asserts what the hunter says should hold, so it fails while the behaviour is present. The finding has no test. This one uses reserves extreme enough that the function runs out of steps, and allows a revert, the fix the finding asks for.

program.name: Code4rena
program.verdict: Valid at the lower class: labelled QA (Quality Assurance), downgraded by judge, sponsor confirmed, grade-c, unsatisfactory. The judge calls it QA (L).

label.why: The sponsor agreed that it should revert, and asked for low severity. The judge wrote that it needs extreme values, so a QA (L) submission. A fix was made upstream.

boundary.moved: Submitted as 2 (Med Risk). Judge alex-ppg downgraded it to QA on 2024-08-21 and kept that on a post-judging challenge.

expected.classReason: The PoC shows calcLpTokenSupply returning a value that moves by 341,995 on one more step, at reserves of 1000e18 and 100 wei, where calcReserve would revert. A wrong answer at an extreme pool state, with no funds taken or locked and no attacker shown: the contract falls short of what it promises, Low.
expected.reason: The program judged it valid at the lower side of a boundary it moved, so Low, against the Medium claimed. Every gate passes, and the class is left to the jury, which A7d measures.
